usage: agentbreeder up [-h] [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--port PORT]
                       [--no-browser] [--yes] [--link] [--set-password |
                       --reset-password]
                       [dir]

positional arguments:
  dir                   A project with agent.yaml, stack.yaml

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
  --port PORT
  --no-browser
  --yes                 With DIR: confirm the grant and start its services
  --link                Print a one-time sign-in link at start (Enter in the
                        terminal makes another)
  --set-password        Set the console's first password from the terminal
                        (read without echo, or one line of stdin), then exit
  --reset-password      Replace a forgotten console password and end every
                        open session, then exit
